Project-wide (stated during area selecti.question: Relationship to Tableau prototype
Project-wide (stated during area selecti.answer: NOT like the Tableau prototype. Standalone project — do not consider Tableau as an example for the rest of the project. Overrides DASH-11 'matching Tableau styling' wording; four chart types remain.

Chart presentation.question: How should the four charts be presented?
Chart presentation.answer: One large hero + three mini previews. Clicking a mini rotates it into the hero slot; former hero becomes a mini.

Chart presentation.question: What do mini previews show?
Chart presentation.answer: Live mini charts — real Recharts renders updating with active filters

Chart presentation.question: Mini preview placement
Chart presentation.answer: Row below the hero (hero full width; minis wrap on narrow screens)

Chart presentation.question: Swap transition
Chart presentation.answer: Quick animated swap ~200–300ms, instant fallback under prefers-reduced-motion

Chart presentation.question: Point inspection (hover banned)
Chart presentation.answer: Click/tap with generous hit area + keyboard arrow navigation via Recharts accessibilityLayer; large-text tooltip stays until dismissed

Chart presentation.question: AHA bands behind BP Timeline
Chart presentation.answer: Subtle low-opacity tinted zones with small edge labels; data lines stay the star

Chart presentation.question: Y-axis scaling
Chart presentation.answer: Fixed clinical range — BP ~40–220 mmHg, Pulse ~30–120 bpm; positions stay meaningful across filter changes

Chart presentation.question: Dots at each reading on line charts
Chart presentation.answer: Dots on lines — discrete measurements made visible; doubles as click targets

Chart presentation.question: Systolic/diastolic line identification
Chart presentation.answer: Direct line labels in large text at line ends, in line color

Chart presentation.question: Zero-readings empty state
Chart presentation.answer: Message + guidance: why it's empty, newest-reading date, big 'Show all data' button

Visual style & colors.question: Overall theme (freeform)
Visual style & colors.answer: Naval/nautical theme — sailboats, ocean, water. Ocean-like colors, minimalistic, pastels + navy.

Visual style & colors.question: Palette split vs high-contrast constraint
Visual style & colors.answer: Pastels as canvas only — pastel ocean tones for backgrounds/cards/surfaces; navy and deep tones carry all text, data lines, interactive elements (WCAG-safe)

Visual style & colors.question: BP category colors
Visual style & colors.answer: Keep clinical semantics — recognizable green/yellow/orange/red (+ blue-grey Hypotension), tuned deeper/desaturated to harmonize with ocean palette

Visual style & colors.question: Light or dark theme
Visual style & colors.answer: Both with a large toggle — light airy nautical AND dark 'night sea'; toggle becomes a voice command later

Visual style & colors.question: Nautical imagery literalness
Visual style & colors.answer: Subtle motifs — sailboat/anchor mark in header, wave-curve dividers, nautical empty states; charts stay clean

Filter controls.question: Date-range presets (7/30/90/All) presentation
Filter controls.answer: Segmented button row — four large side-by-side buttons, active one filled navy; 1:1 mapping to future voice commands

Filter controls.question: Custom date range entry (no precision pointing)
Filter controls.answer: Large month/day pickers — From/To fields opening oversized calendar with ≥48px day cells, plus direct typing for keyboard users

Filter controls.question: AM/PM and BP-category filter mechanics
Filter controls.answer: Button groups, single-select — AM/PM as [All|AM|PM] segmented buttons; category as one row of large chips, tap to isolate, tap again for all

Filter controls.question: Filter placement
Filter controls.answer: Horizontal bar above hero — between header and hero chart, wrapping on narrow screens; state always visible
